mechanism: Amitriptyline's anticholinergic and sodium-retaining effects combined with eplerenone's potassium-sparing mechanism increase hyperkalemia risk, particularly with concurrent renal impairment or ACE inhibitor/ARB use.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function closely; consider baseline and periodic ECG; educate patient on dietary potassium restriction; dose adjustment of eplerenone may be needed.
